aj: Quick two-question poll! @here TL;DR: pick your editor + late-night office order. Reply with the number or emoji.

1) Editor — 1: Vim :v:, 2: Emacs :leek:, 3: VSCode :vscode:, 4: Neovim :neovim:
2) Late-night grub — A: 🍕 Pizza, B: 🍣 Sushi, C: 🥗 Salad, D: 🌯 Burrito

I'll tally in ~20m. No pressure, very scientific :mag:!

maria: 3 + A (VSCode + 🍕). pizza all the way. :pizza:

devon: 4 + D (Neovim + 🌯). burrito fuel for late-night deploys. :taco:

karen: 1 + A (Vim + 🍕). nostalgia vote. :heart_eyes:

sam: 3 + B (VSCode + 🍣). sushi stan. Also can we make a sticker set of editors? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

aj: Thanks! quick interim tally: Editors — VSCode 2, Neovim 1, Vim 1, Emacs 0. Grub — Pizza 2, Burrito 1, Sushi 1, Salad 0.

ops-bot: Poll note: reactions registered. (auto-reminder in 10m) :bell:

maria: Also +1 for editor stickers, vote for VSCode sticker idea. would buy. :money_with_wings:

aj: Finalizing — closing poll now and ordering for team late-night run. Final tally: Editors — VSCode 2, Neovim 1, Vim 1, Emacs 0. Grub — Pizza 2, Burrito 1, Sushi 1, Salad 0.

aj: Action items: 1) Order two large pizzas + 1 burrito tray + 1 sushi platter? opinions? 2) @devex can you mock up VSCode sticker concept for hackweek?

devon: +1 on pizzas + burrito (sushi fragile at 2am).

karen: Agree on pizzas. and yes to sticker mockup.

aj: Cool — will place order. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
